probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __and wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), and wherein the speaker further comprises a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 1cm3__.

2. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer __comprises a silicone__.

3. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded.

4. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the back volume (36) is less than 0.5cm3.

8. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the resonant frequency is below 300 Hz.

9. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the resonant frequency is below 250 Hz.

10. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa __and comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; __providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8)__; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2) __and providing a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 1cm3__.

11. (Currently amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer __comprises silicone__.

12. (Previously presented) A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

13. (Currently amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, 11 or 12, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding.

14. (Cancelled)
